title: A timer Pre-Vote round outlives the node's own leader establishment and demotes the new leader
cause: establish_leader/become_leader keep pre_candidate, and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() without the timer's leader/voter checks.
trigger: With Pre-Vote enabled the timer starts a Pre-Vote round on a Candidate; the original election then wins; a late Pre-Vote grant for that round arrives.
consequence: The freshly elected leader steps down to Candidate at term+1 while keeping its Leader object; RaftCore panics on try_leader_handler's leader.vote >= state.vote assertion (debug builds).
premises: Pre-Vote is enabled (Config::enable_pre_vote = Some(true) or runtime toggle).

Vote responses can arrive after the Candidate's election timer fired but within the vote RPC timeout (vote persistence/command-drain latency exceeds election_timeout - election_timeout_min plus tick phase).
